title: Sulfur Cube - Simplified fix
description: Fix the Sulfer Cube texture when it has an transparent block inside
body:
# Make the textures of the Sulfer Cube simplified to fix some texture bugs when he has an transparent block inside

**To put transparent block inside you can use command or [my datapack](https://modrinth.com/project/f2J6VVJl)**
